title: Battle of Karánsebes
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Karánsebes", at revision 1378507121, opens: "The Battle of Karánsebes was a friendly fire incident in the Austrian army, occurring during the night of 21–22 September 1788, during the Austro-Turkish War of 1788–1791. Some historians have referred to the battle as "history's worst friendly fire incident"." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2309898, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "friendly fire incident during the Austro–Turkish War of 1787–1791". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
